create_serializer: create a Serializer subclass that converts a PyTorch tensor to bytes with shape and dtype metadata
build_deserializer: build a Deserializer subclass that reconstructs a PyTorch tensor from serialized bytes
test_to_bytes: test the Serializer.to_bytes method with tensors of varying shapes, dtypes, and devices
test_from_bytes: test the Deserializer.from_bytes method to verify round-trip tensor serialization and deserialization
review_serializer_deserializer: review the Serializer and Deserializer base classes for proper abstract method enforcement and dtype handling
